Basic prayer received at the start of the game from [[Bishop]].  A successful sermon creates donations at the base rate of <span style = "display:inline-block;">3{{Copper Coin}}:1{{Graveyard Rating}}</span>, and will produce faith at a rate of <span style = "display:inline-block;">1[[file:faith item.png|22px]]:5{{Church Rating}}</span>.
